meal.name: Marathon Bolognese over pasta
meal.swaps: pasta→GF pasta (gluten-free); pasta→wholemeal (more fibre for everyday, the Cyclist.co.uk pro-team version); beef→lentils (vegan)
meal.why: veg-loaded meat sauce over pasta — the night-before-a-long-run dinner a marathon champion cooked from
meal.attribution: Shalane Flanagan & Elyse Kopecky, "Run Fast. Cook Fast. Eat Slow." — a favourite during Flanagan's 2017 NYC Marathon build https://justcook.butcherbox.com/the-amazing-simple-marathon-bolognese-recipe-from-the-authors-of-run-fast-cook-fast-eat-slow/ ; Jonny Brownlee's meatballs-and-pasta rotation, 220triathlon.com
meal.ingredients: ground beef 100g, carrot ½, celery 1 stalk, onion ¼, crushed tomatoes 200g, red wine splash, pasta 120g dry (makes 6)

methodSteps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add 100g ground beef with a pinch of salt and cook, breaking it into bite-size pieces, about 3 minutes until lightly browned.
Finely dice ½ carrot, 1 stalk celery and ¼ onion, add to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in a splash of red wine and let it bubble for 1 minute to cook off the alcohol.
Add 200g crushed tomatoes, bring to the boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, about 25 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Taste and add more salt and pepper if needed.
Meanwhile, cook 120g pasta in salted boiling water until al dente; drain and serve topped with the bolognese.
meal.source: Shalane Flanagan & Elyse Kopecky, "Run Fast. Cook Fast.
